⚠ First unfavorable maintenance month of 2026: August Facilities spend came in at $395K vs $361K in August 2025 — the first month this year Facilities maintenance itself ran over prior year (+9.3%), driven mainly by a $70.6K jump in HVAC spend. Work order volume also exceeded 2025 for the first time (325 vs 319, +1.9%). PM remained elevated (+11.7% for the month). Still, YTD totals stay solidly favorable — Facilities −29.0%, CAPEX −57.9%, Total −50.3% — with CAPEX continuing to do the heavy lifting on savings.

August highlights: Extermination Services flipped unfavorable YTD (+2.3%) after a heavy August ($27.1K vs $9.4K in August 2025) — reversing the favorable trend seen in June and July. Doors remains over 2025 (+10.1% YTD) but the gap narrowed from July's +20.5% as August itself ran below prior year. Equipment (+140.3%) and Supplies (+50.3%) remain the largest %-swing watch items but stay small in absolute dollars. General Contractor, Racking, and Landscaping continue running 54–80% below 2025, consistent with reduced project activity.
